tools.name: search_fonts
tools.description: Use this when the person wants fonts for something: a style or mood, a use, a font by name, or a language to cover. For example "a warm serif", "a playful display font for a poster" or "a monospace for code". query is their words, at most 200 characters. category narrows to sans-serif, serif, monosp

tools.name: get_font
tools.description: Use this when the person asks about one font: its weights and styles, its license, the languages it covers, or what to pair it with. id is a family's id, its name in lowercase with hyphens ("lora", "space-mono"). Not for the CSS that loads a font on a page. Answers one family: its name, page link, c

tools.name: get_font_css
tools.description: Use this when the person wants to use fonts on a web page, in an app or in a design tool that takes CSS. ids are 1 to 4 family ids, like "lora" or "space-mono". weights are 100 to 900; each family gets the ones it has, its regular and bold when left out. italic adds the italic of each weight a famil
